scripts.start: npm run docker:prod:up && npm run db:prod:init && npm run build:cypher && tsx src/app.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run build:cypher && npm run test:unit && npm run test:setup && npm run test:integration:run && npm run test:functional:run && npm run docker:test:down
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration:dev && npm run docker:test:down
scripts.test:integration:dev: npm run test:setup && npm run test:integration:run
scripts.test:integration:gds: npm run test:setup && vitest --run --project gds-projection-tests --project gds-similarity-tests && npm run docker:test:down
scripts.test:integration:reason: npm run test:setup && vitest --run --project reason-tests && npm run docker:test:down
scripts.test:functional: npm run test:setup && npm run test:functional:run && npm run docker:test:down
scripts.test:setup: docker compose --env-file .env.test up neo4j-test -d --wait && npm run db:test:init
scripts.docker:prod:down: docker compose --env-file .env.prod stop neo4j-prod && docker compose --env-file .env.prod rm -f neo4j-prod
scripts.docker:test:down: docker compose --env-file .env.test stop neo4j-test && docker compose --env-file .env.test rm -f neo4j-test
scripts.db:prod:init: scripts/db.sh prod -f /tmp/init.cypher && scripts/import-skills.sh prod && scripts/import-reasons.sh prod && scripts/import-languages.sh prod
scripts.db:prod:clean: scripts/db.sh prod -d neo4j "MATCH (n) DETACH DELETE n"
scripts.db:prod:status: scripts/db.sh prod -d neo4j "MATCH (n) RETURN count(n) as total_nodes"
scripts.db:test:init: scripts/db.sh test -f /tmp/init.cypher && scripts/import-skills.sh test && scripts/import-reasons.sh test && scripts/import-languages.sh test
scripts.db:test:clean: scripts/db.sh test -d neo4j "MATCH (n) DETACH DELETE n"
scripts.db:test:status: scripts/db.sh test -d neo4j "MATCH (n) RETURN count(n) as total_nodes"
scripts.structurizr:down: docker compose stop structurizr && docker compose rm -f structurizr
scripts.structurizr:restart: npm run structurizr:down && npm run structurizr:up
